```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mental_health <- read_csv("deprivation.csv")

mental_health_clean <- mental_health %>%
  select(
    SIMD,
    PatientsRates,
    FinancialYear,
    Dataset,
    HBR
  )

plot_data_all <- mental_health_clean %>%
  filter(
    Dataset == "SMR04",
    HBR == "S92000003",
    SIMD %in% 1:5,
    !is.na(PatientsRates)
  )

plot_data_trend <- plot_data_all %>%
  group_by(FinancialYear, SIMD) %>%
  summarise(
    PatientsRates = mean(PatientsRates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_data_trend,
       aes(x = FinancialYear,
           y = PatientsRates,
           color = factor(SIMD),
           group = SIMD)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c(
      "1997/98",
      "2002/03",
      "2007/08",
      "2012/13",
      "2017/18",
      "2022/23"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by Deprivation",
    subtitle = "Scotland: Trends Over Time",
    x = "Financial Year",
    y = "Patients per 100,000 Population",
    color = "SIMD Quintile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
mean_data <- deprivation %>%
   group_by(FinancialYear, SIMD) %>%
   summarise(mean_rate = mean(DischargeRates, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(mean_data,mapping=aes(x=FinancialYear,y=mean_rate,color=SIMD,group = SIMD))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2)+
  scale_color_manual(                                      
    values = c("1" = "#D94F50",  
       "2" = "#4B86B4", 
       "3" = "#5B9A68",  
       "4" = "#9B72AA",  
       "5" = "#E59866",  
       "6" = "#B3A27F" ),
     name = "SIMD") +
     scale_x_discrete(breaks = my_breaks) +
   labs(title="The Trend of Discharge Rates", subtitle="1997-2024", x="Financial Year", y="The Mean of Discharge Rate")+
   theme_minimal()+
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
